Subcontractors.Title: Subcontractor Marketplace Access
Subcontractors.Description: Provide subcontractors with access to a job marketplace where they can find and apply for work offerings related to property maintenance and repairs.

Subcontractors.Title: Job Application Management
Subcontractors.Description: Enable subcontractors to apply for jobs, manage their applications, and view the status of their bids, facilitating an organized approach to securing contracts.

Subcontractors.Title: Communication and Coordination
Subcontractors.Description: Facilitate effective communication between subcontractors, property managers, and tenants through an integrated chat system to discuss job details and coordinate schedules.

Subcontractors.Title: Profile and Credentials Management
Subcontractors.Description: Allow subcontractors to create and manage their profiles, showcasing their credentials, past work, and areas of expertise to enhance their visibility in the marketplace.

Subcontractors.Title: Financial Transaction Management
Subcontractors.Description: Provide a secure platform for subcontractors to receive payments for completed jobs through integrated financial services like Stripe, including managing invoices and transaction history.

Subcontractors.Title: Feedback and Ratings
Subcontractors.Description: Implement a system where subcontractors can receive feedback and ratings from property managers and tenants, helping to build their reputation in the community.

Property Managers.Title: Property Listing Management
Property Managers.Description: Enable property managers to add, update, and remove property listings, including detailed descriptions, amenities, rules, and photos to attract potential tenants.

Property Managers.Title: Lease Management
Property Managers.Description: Facilitate the creation, updating, renewal, and termination of lease agreements, including the use of templates, e-signing via DocuSign, and managing lease durations.

Property Managers.Title: Financial Transactions and Reporting
Property Managers.Description: Manage financial aspects including rent collection, security deposits, and service fee payments through Stripe, and provide detailed financial reports and analytics.

Property Managers.Title: Maintenance Request Coordination
Property Managers.Description: Handle maintenance and repair requests from tenants, delegate tasks to subcontractors, and manage status updates from request to completion.

Property Managers.Title: Tenant Management
Property Managers.Description: Oversee tenant profiles, rental applications, tenant verification via SingleKey, and maintain a communication channel between property managers and tenants.

Property Managers.Title: Appointment Scheduling
Property Managers.Description: Integrate with Calendly to facilitate the scheduling of property visits for tenants and subcontractors, and manage calendar views for availability.

Property Managers.Title: Access and Permission Controls
Property Managers.Description: Define and manage access permissions across different functionalities of the platform to secure sensitive information and operations.

Property Managers.Title: User Role Management
Property Managers.Description: Create and manage different user roles within the platform, specifically focusing on roles under property management like secondary property managers or administrative staff.

Property Managers.Title: Security and Compliance
Property Managers.Description: Ensure the platform conforms to Canadian laws for data protection and privacy, implementing necessary security protocols for safeguarding user data.

Property Managers.Title: Platform Customization and Settings
Property Managers.Description: Allow property managers to customize platform settings such as notification preferences, report configurations, and interface layouts.

Tenants.Title: Tenant Authentication
Tenants.Description: Enable tenants to securely log in and out of the platform using their registered credentials, and manage their session with features like 'Remember Me' and 'Forgot Password'.

Tenants.Title: Tenant Profile Management
Tenants.Description: Allow tenants to create, view, and update their profiles with personal and contact information, manage their bank/card details for payments, and handle their documents.

Tenants.Title: Property Search and Listings
Tenants.Description: Provide tenants with functionalities to search for properties based on various filters, view listings with detailed information, and manage their saved/bookmarked properties.

Tenants.Title: Lease Application and Management
Tenants.Description: Facilitate tenants to apply for leases, view the status of their applications, manage ongoing leases, and handle lease renewals and terminations.

Tenants.Title: Payment Management
Tenants.Description: Enable tenants to make secure payments for rent and security deposits, view their payment history, and manage their payment methods.

Tenants.Title: Maintenance Request System
Tenants.Description: Allow tenants to submit maintenance requests, track the status of these requests, and communicate with property managers and subcontractors regarding these requests.

Tenants.Title: Appointment Booking
Tenants.Description: Provide a system for tenants to schedule and manage appointments with property managers or for property visits through integration with Calendly.

Tenants.Title: Notifications and Alerts
Tenants.Description: Implement a notification system to alert tenants about important events such as lease renewals, payment due dates, and maintenance request updates.

Tenants.Title: Feedback and Reviews
Tenants.Description: Allow tenants to give feedback on properties and services, and view reviews from other tenants to help them make informed decisions.

Tenants.Title: Tenant Verification
Tenants.Description: Integrate with third-party services like SingleKey to verify tenant credentials during the lease application process.
